title: Agri Innovation Challenge 2027 — National Finale
description:
Pilot on a real farm. Launch to market.

The Agri Innovation Challenge is GRIS Canada's national competition for agri-food ventures. At the national finale, Canada's best early-stage and growth-stage agri-food ventures pitch live for a $50,000+ cash prize pool, farm pilots and commercialization support.

Who can enter: Canadian universities, colleges, startups and farmers working in agtech, sustainability, and food & consumer products. Applications open Winter 2027.

Two tracks
• Early-Stage Track ($0–$500K revenue): prove technical feasibility, on-farm usefulness and that customers will pay (prototypes, field trials, LOIs and paid pilots).
• Growth-Stage Track ($500K+ revenue): prove repeatable unit economics, multi-season retention and a supply chain that scales.

What finalists get
• A share of the $50,000+ cash prize pool
• A pilot launch on a GRIS farm site in BC, with grower feedback and measured results
• Go-to-market help: buyer and retail introductions, an Agri Hub marketplace listing and mentoring on pricing
• Capital connections: introductions to investors, lenders and grant programs

Six awards: Best AgTech Innovation · Best Sustainability & Climate Impact · Best Food & Consumer Product · Youth Agri-Entrepreneur (ages 18–39) · Women in Agriculture · Audience Choice

Finale day (proposed run of show, Eastern Time)
8:30 am  Registration, breakfast and agtech showcase opens
9:30 am  Welcome from the University of Guelph and GRIS Canada
10:00 am  Early-Stage Track finalist pitches
12:00 pm  Lunch, showcase and investor/lender meetings
1:30 pm  Growth-Stage Track finalist pitches
3:30 pm  Panel: research to farm to market
4:30 pm  Audience Choice vote and jury deliberation
5:00 pm  Awards ceremony
5:45 pm  Networking reception

About 250–400 founders, judges, farmers, sponsors, investors, students and faculty. Host partnership with the University of Guelph and session timings are being finalized.

Questions: info@griscanada.org · www.griscanada.org

title: AgriFest Canada 2027
location: First edition in BC · location to be announced
description:
AgriFest Canada is GRIS Canada's annual public festival: one day on the farm that brings families, farmers, agtech companies and government together. The first edition is in BC in Summer 2027, with more locations across Canada to follow. Dates and location will be announced here.

What happens at AgriFest
• Technology Showcase / AgriTech Live: drones, autonomous tractors, greenhouse robotics and sensor demos from GRIS AgTech partners
• Government & financing programs: federal and provincial program desks for farmers and founders
• Farmers' Market: fresh produce and artisan goods from local growers
• Food vendors: local food trucks and farm-to-table stalls
• Competition & awards: AgriFest prizes, plus a showcase of Agri Innovation Challenge winners
• Live music stage: local bands, cultural performances and announcements
• Kids' Zone (Future Farmers): U-pick, planting, farm animals and activities for kids of all ages

Year-one targets: 3,000–5,000 visitors, 40+ exhibitors and vendors, and 20+ agtech demos.

Organized by the Green Revolution Innovation Society (GRIS) · www.griscanada.org · info@griscanada.org
